programme.desc: World War II was the most tragic armed conflict in the history of mankind, which was not forgotten long after the last shot was fired.Decades after the end of the battles, their effects are felt, and many of the stories and facts related to them remain a mystery - they are passed over in silence by the victors or lost in the archives.The program reveals some of them.Dunkirk and D-Day, the German Blitz, the Battle of Britain and the incredible feats of Polish pilots from 303 Squadron, who played a key role in the final victory of the Allied forces, are just some of the key moments of the war, the unknown threads of which are only now becoming public.

programme.title: Smoke \u0026 Steel
programme.desc: The industrial revolution changed the world.Although often unconsciously, we still benefit from the achievements of this era - groundbreaking designs, inventions and discoveries.One of them is the excavation of a tunnel under the Thames.The success of this venture initiated the construction of underground structures.Urban planning works in Prague had a huge impact on the rapid development of European cities.In turn, the creation of planetary observatories changed human perception of the universe.The use of steam engines had an impact on many areas of life, including:for the development of transport and tourism.The Trans-Siberian Railway, a desperate attempt to connect the east and west of the great Russian territory, had an impact on the outcome of the war, and a warship off the southern coast of England contributed to a change in naval warfare tactics.The program presents not only those structures that are still in use, but also those that are historical attractions.
